negative_space_opening.scope: One horizontal cut through actual piecewise-linear mesh section; open to the sides, not a sealed cavity or global minimum clearance.

cap_edge_note: Terminal outline has 4 mm in-plane rounded corners. Cap-to-face thickness edge remains a hard boundary; no claim of all-direction edge fillet.
limits: Matched vertex pairs and longitudinal edge midpoints are finite discrete samples, not a global minimum wall-thickness certificate.
Dimensions and contacts are digital geometry; no forming allowance, tolerance, load, friction, or ergonomics validation.
